cases.name: Adjacent roles
cases.prompt: Compare operations analyst and people manager. I build weekly backlog reports and brief supervisors but have no direct reports. I want hands-on analysis.
expectations: Uses reporting and briefings as evidence for the analyst direction.
Distinguishes briefing supervisors from managing direct reports.
Accounts for the preference for analysis.
Provides a concrete next artifact or practice task.

cases.name: Compensation without context
cases.prompt: A friend says analysts make 95k. Can I expect that? I haven't picked a city or level.
expectations: Identifies currency and compensation basis as relevant.
Treats the friend’s figure as unverified.
Returns a comparison method without promising a salary.

cases.name: Time-constrained development
cases.prompt: A posting asks for SQL joins. I know spreadsheets and have two hours a week for three weeks. Should I buy a certification?
expectations: Separates spreadsheet experience from evidence of joins.
Proposes a small joins exercise with an inspectable result.
Fits the next checkpoint within the available three weeks.
Avoids asserting that a paid credential is required.
